description:
Travesty Candles isn't just another candle company; we're an experience. Our candles serve as little reminders of fond memories in the Pacific NW. We focus on local partnerships to support local handmade artists. And each of our candles are hand poured locally in the Pacific NW.

We make our candles so that you can have a small reminder in your home that speaks to the beauty and mysticism of the Pacific NW, whether you're from here, you want to take a piece of it with you when you leave, or you want to send someone a gift that makes them laugh and remember this place fondly. And we add a touch of the humor that's so prevalent here to most of our candles.
